result.summary: Sell a fixed-scope local listing cleanup sprint for clinics and local service businesses: audit stale public profiles, document owner-authorized corrections, and deliver a short proof packet instead of a vague SEO retainer.
result.opportunity: Local businesses lose trust and calls when Google Business Profile and other public listing details are stale, inconsistent or incomplete; review quality and accurate listing data are visible buyer signals and can be repaired in a short, bounded engagement.
result.target_customer: Spanish dental, cosmetic and private medical clinics, plus other local service businesses with an active Google Business Profile and a public website or directory presence but inconsistent hours, contact details, services or review-response gaps.
result.offer: A fixed-scope listing cleanup sprint: public-profile audit, discrepancy check across Google/Bing/Apple/website contact data, owner-authorized correction plan, review-response template pack, and a 1-page proof-of-change report with before/after notes.
result.price: 149 EUR for the first listing cleanup sprint; 79 EUR per additional local directory or follow-up sync.
result.why_now: Google offers Business Profiles for free and explicitly frames them as a way to reach more customers, while BrightLocal's 2026 survey found that 97% of consumers read reviews before choosing a local business and that review profile quality and freshness directly affect trust and action. This makes accurate local listings and review-response readiness a visible, actionable pain point for business owners now.
actions_completed: Reviewed the 100-route monetization playbook and the seed routes relevant to direct B2B services.
Reviewed recent IAMO attempts to avoid repeating crowded GBP review-audit patterns and generic SEO offers.
Validated external evidence through BrightLocal's local-review survey and Google's Business Profile landing page.
Prepared a concrete execution packet with target customer, offer, pricing, channel, message, deliverable and CobrAMO payment reference.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email to a business owner's public contact email or contact form, sent one-to-one after identifying a concrete inconsistency in their public listing; no bulk outreach, no mass mailing.
execution_packet.subject: Quick fix for your local listing trust and visibility
execution_packet.message:
Hi [Name],
I noticed a few details in your public business listing that may be reducing trust and calls: [hours/contact/service wording/review response pattern], and they do not match the way customers expect a local clinic to appear online.
I help local businesses clean up public business listings and owner-authorized profile details so the information is consistent, easier to trust, and more likely to convert. The first pass is a fixed-scope audit and correction sprint for 149 EUR, including a short before/after proof report and a practical action list.
If helpful, I can send a 3-point sample of the issues I would fix and the exact changes I would recommend. Reference: RANK-IAMO507.
Best,
IAMO507 / DesarrollAMO
execution_packet.deliverable: A one-page listing audit with screenshot or profile evidence, prioritized discrepancies, owner-authorized correction list, optional review-response templates, and a brief before/after summary.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I avoided repeating the generic Google Business Profile review-recovery and landing-page patterns used by recent IAMOs. This version is narrower and more defensible: a documented listing cleanup service focused on public-data accuracy and owner-authorized corrections, which is easier to explain, easier to prove, and lower-friction to sell than a broad SEO or dashboard pitch.
result.next_step: Identify 15-20 Spanish clinics or local service businesses with active profiles and obvious public-data inconsistencies; send one tailored note with two concrete issues and the fixed price; if they respond, send a 3-point sample audit and close the first 149 EUR listing cleanup via CobrAMO using reference RANK-IAMO507.
result.notes: Considered playbook routes #87 Local listing/profile cleanup service and #31 website technical audit; chose #87 because it aligns with direct B2B, low cost, and clear evidence of a real pain. Risks: local-business owners may prefer an agency-managed service, and some listing changes require owner access or platform policy compliance; the offer remains bounded to audit + documented corrections rather than promises of guaranteed local rankings. This is a sales-ready execution packet, not a verified revenue claim.
